title: Blaze prefill tests failed at collection on an import of a helper that was never added
summary: Nightly Blaze Models Prefill tests failed to collect test_prefill_transformer_chunked.py: ImportError for sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows from models.demos.deepseek_v3_d_p.tt.tt_ccl. Seven test legs failed this way in run 40452853696.

environment.job: Galaxy-Blaze-models-prefill / (GLM-5.3-744B) chunked prefill accuracy code_debug 55k@5k + padded 15k@5k, no-trace and traced [bh_sc1]

recommendation: When two changes touch the same module, re-run test collection (pytest --collect-only) on the merged result; import the helper that the module actually defines.
evidence: [1,0]<stdout>: E   ImportError: cannot import name 'sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows' from 'models.demos.deepseek_v3_d_p.tt.tt_ccl' (/home/runner/_work/tt-metal/tt-metal/models/demos/deepseek_v3_d_p/tt/tt_ccl.py)
root_cause: PR #62411 changed test_prefill_transformer_chunked.py to import sparse_mla_overlap_gather_rows from tt_ccl, but PR #62477, merged about two hours earlier, kept the constant _SPARSE_MLA_OVERLAP_GATHER_ROWS = 1 and never added the function; at commit c7b41d5c7 tt_ccl.py defines only the constant, so test collection failed with ImportError.

fix.description: Commit c30746f89 (PR #62673) made the test use _SPARSE_MLA_OVERLAP_GATHER_ROWS again. The first nightly run that included it (40635507280, head 1768d2e38) passed this job.
